title: The Brave Heart
moral: Courage isn't about not being scared—it's about doing the right thing anyway
description: An inspiring story about overcoming fears and discovering inner strength

pages.title: Scared of the Dark
pages.text: {childName} was always a little scared of the dark. But tonight was different—{friendName} needed help!
pages.illustrationPrompt: Child standing at the edge of darkness, looking nervous but determined. Behind them a lit room, ahead is mysterious darkness. Concerned but brave expression. Style: slightly dramatic, age-appropriate spooky

pages.title: The Problem
pages.text: {friendName}'s {petName} had wandered into the dark woods near {setting} and they couldn't find it. '{childName}, will you help me?' asked {friendName} with tears in their eyes.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Friend looking upset and worried. {petName} lost in dark woods visible in distance. Emotional moment showing the problem. Both children standing at the edge of light and darkness. Style: empathetic, showing the challenge

pages.title: Takes a Deep Breath
pages.text: {childName} took a deep breath. Even though they were scared, they loved {friendName}. 'Let's find your {petName}. I'll go with you.'
pages.illustrationPrompt: Child taking a deep breath, eyes closed for a moment. Can show determination building. Hands clenching in resolve. {friendName} watching with hope. Style: moment of inner strength building

pages.title: Into the Woods
pages.text: They stepped into the woods together. The darkness felt thick, but {childName} held {friendName}'s hand tightly. 'We've got this!' whispered {childName}.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Two children walking into forest holding hands. Trees tall around them. Shadows but some moonlight filtering through. Path ahead. Showing solidarity and support. Style: brave but realistic

pages.title: Strange Sounds
pages.text: A branch snapped. 'What was that?' gasped {friendName}. {childName}'s heart was pounding, but they didn't give up. 'It's okay. Let's keep looking.'
pages.illustrationPrompt: Both children reacting to sound in dark forest. Scared expressions but not giving up. Silhouette of something moving (later revealed as harmless). Shadows and tree branches. Tension building. Style: spooky but age-appropriate

pages.title: Not So Scary After All
pages.text: Suddenly, they saw it—just a deer walking through the trees! Not scary at all. They both laughed with relief.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Gentle deer in clearing with moonlight. Both children laughing, relief and joy on faces. Realization moment that scary things aren't always dangerous. Warm, relieving scene. Style: comforting, funny

pages.title: Following the Sound
pages.text: Then they heard a familiar sound. 'Is that...?' 'Yes! It's {petName}!' They followed the sound and found {petName} in a small clearing.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Finding {petName} in clearing. {petName} happy and safe. Children rushing toward it joyfully. Moonlight illuminating the scene. Relief and happiness filling the scene. Style: joyful reunion

pages.title: The Hero
pages.text: {friendName} hugged {childName} tight. 'You're so brave! You were scared but you did it anyway. That's true courage!'
pages.illustrationPrompt: Children hugging with {petName} between them. All happy and safe. Can show both crying happy tears. Stars or moonlight above. Sense of accomplishment. Style: emotional, rewarding

pages.title: Walking Back Home
pages.text: Walking back through the woods didn't feel scary anymore. They laughed and talked the whole way. '{childName}, will you always be this brave?' asked {friendName}.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Walking back with {petName}, both children smiling. Woods now seeming less scary. Warm light ahead showing the way home. Companionship and confidence. Style: triumphant, transformative

pages.title: Courage Lives Inside
pages.text: {childName} smiled. 'I think courage was inside me all along. I just needed to take that first brave step.' And {friendName} knew that was true.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Child standing tall, sunlight/starlight shining. Hand on chest, over heart. Looking peaceful and confident. {friendName} and {petName} beside them. Scene showing growth and inner strength. Style: inspiring, empowering conclusion
